scripts.release: export WXT_RELEASE=true && wxt build && wxt zip && mkdir -p releases && cp .output/anycap-extension-0.2.0-chrome.zip releases/anycap-extension-0.2.0-chrome.zip && node scripts/sync-release-hash.mjs
scripts.preflight:local: pnpm release && pnpm test && npx tsc --noEmit && pnpm verify:release
scripts.e2e: node scripts/confirm-headed-e2e.mjs && pnpm build && playwright test
scripts.e2e:demo: node scripts/confirm-headed-e2e.mjs && pnpm demo && ANYCAP_E2E_MODE=demo playwright test tests/e2e/sidepanel-tabs.spec.ts tests/e2e/demo-mock.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:real: node scripts/confirm-headed-e2e.mjs && pnpm build && ANYCAP_E2E_MODE=real playwright test tests/e2e/real-flow.spec.ts
